column1: REGISTRATION  OF  TITLE ACT, No.  21 OF  1998
Declaration  of  Determination  of  the  Commissioner  of  Title  Settlement  under  Section  14
BY virtue of the powers vested in me under Section 14 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998, I, the undersigned, hereby de-
clare my determination as set out in the Schedule appended hereto in regard to the  title to parcel of Land Nos. 87, 97, 123 and 128 of
Block 01, contained in the Cadastral Map No. 410029, situated in the Village of Dummaladeniya within the Grama Niladhari Division
of No. 490 A Dummaladedeniya North in the Divisional Secretary's Division of Wennapuwa, in the District of Puttalam, in the Province
of  North  Western,  referred  to  in Notice  No. 41/0183  calling  for  claims  to  land parcels  which  was  duly  published  in  the  Gazette  No.
2079/24 of 10th July, 2018 in terms of Section 12 of the Registration of Title Act, No.21 of 1998.
